UI-030: Production score workspace and Concert/F-Horn context preservation (#52)

Score-centered workspace for SCORE_READY+ states (GUI_UX_SPEC §6-§12,
§15), lifting the verified UI-003/UI-005 spike patterns into production.

src/score/ (new module — rendering, identity, sync, inspector):
- verovio.ts: WASM toolkit wrapper (inlined binary, fully offline, lazy
  chunk); continuous/page modes, zoom 25-200%, renderToSVG only off the
  frame path
- ids.ts: FND-001 mirror — hs-sn-* export ids -> sn-* canonical ids;
  Verovio random ids never resolve
- scoreDoc.ts: MusicXML -> flat note model for the a11y inspector path
- domScore.ts: element index + DOM-only marks (selected/active/loop/
  measure wash/caret/review), transparent hit areas for hollow noteheads
- playbackTable.ts: precomputed ms->canonical table from the timemap —
  the rAF pump never calls into WASM
- clock.ts: TransportClock port + ScoreCursorClock (deterministic rAF
  cursor until real audio wiring lands)
- review.ts: ReviewIssue mirror of domain/review.py reason/severity/status
- document.ts + fixtureDocument.ts: typed ScoreDocumentPort; deterministic
  adapter over the UI-005 sync fixtures (identical hs-sn-* ids in both
  presentations, fixed review issues) — engine data slots in later
- ScoreView.tsx: scroll region, click->export id, background deselect,
  manual-navigation signal
- ScoreReadyWorkspace.tsx: orchestrator — canonical selection survives
  Concert<->F管 switches with scroll ratio, transport position, loop and
  playback state intact; follow playback with manual-scroll suspension
  and explicit 追従を再開; review navigation strip; zoom bound to the
  same methods the registry commands invoke
- inspector.ts: view-model builder — note rows (concert/written pitch,
  duration, onset, tie, issues) + nothing-selected score summary

Shared wiring (minimal/additive):
- screen.ts: §27 screen state machine + hasScoreScreen
- App.tsx: screen state, fixture document, controller/state bridge into
  the existing command context (no component-local key handling)
- ScoreWorkspace.tsx: screen-aware body (EMPTY/AUDIO_READY kept as-is)
- PropertiesPanel.tsx: prop-driven inspector renderer (plain DOM for
  Narrator)
- TransportBar.tsx: live timecode + follow-state button
- ja.ts: append-only UI-030 copy deck (scoreView/inspector/reviewReasons/
  reviewSeverity/reviewStatus)
- styles.css: score workspace, page, marks, review cue, follow note
- tauri.conf.json: script-src +wasm-unsafe-eval — required to compile
  the inlined Verovio WASM inside the webview (UI-003 finding); the
  .d.ts/docstrings carry the rationale since JSON has no comments

Tests: 53 new vitest cases (ids, playbackTable, clock, scoreDoc, domScore,
inspector, fixtureDocument) — 111 total green; tsc/eslint clean; pytest
333 green.

Refs #26
